WITH district_high_schools AS (
  SELECT
    s.CDSCode,
    s.School AS school_name,
    s.GSserved,
    s.GSoffered,
    s.NCESDist
  FROM schools s
  WHERE
    s.NCESDist = '0613360'
    AND s.StatusType = 'Active'
    AND (
      -- Must actually enroll students in grade 12
      s.GSserved LIKE '%12%'
    )
),
sat_counts AS (
  SELECT cds AS CDSCode, SUM(NumTstTakr) AS sat_takers
  FROM satscores
  GROUP BY cds
),
hs_with_sat AS (
  SELECT
    d.CDSCode,
    d.school_name,
    d.GSserved,
    d.GSoffered,
    COALESCE(s.sat_takers, 0) AS sat_takers
  FROM district_high_schools d
  LEFT JOIN sat_counts s ON d.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
),
eligible_schools AS (
  SELECT
    CDSCode,
    school_name,
    GSserved,
    GSoffered
  FROM hs_with_sat
  WHERE sat_takers = 0
),
split_grades AS (
  SELECT
    CDSCode,
    school_name,
    GSserved,
    GSoffered,
    CASE 
      WHEN GSserved LIKE 'PK%' THEN 0
      WHEN GSserved LIKE 'TK%' THEN 0.5
      WHEN GSserved LIKE 'KG%' THEN 1
      WHEN GSserved GLOB '[0-9]*' THEN CAST(substr(GSserved,1,2) AS INTEGER)+1
      ELSE 99
    END AS low_grade
  FROM eligible_schools
)
, min_grade as (
  SELECT MIN(low_grade) as earliest_grade FROM split_grades
)
SELECT school_name, GSserved AS grade_span_served
FROM split_grades, min_grade
WHERE split_grades.low_grade = min_grade.earliest_grade
ORDER BY school_name ASC
LIMIT 100

WITH frpm_active_charter AS (
  SELECT 
    f.CDSCode, 
    f.[Charter Funding Type] AS funding_category,
    s.StatusType,
    f.[Enrollment (K-12)] AS enrollment,
    f.[Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)] AS meal_eligible_pct
  FROM frpm f
  INNER JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
  WHERE f.[Charter Funding Type] IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded')
    AND s.StatusType = 'Active'
    AND f.[Academic Year] = '2014-2015'
),
sat_scores AS (
  SELECT 
    sa.cds AS CDSCode,
    sa.AvgScrRead,
    sa.AvgScrMath,
    sa.AvgScrWrite,
    (IFNULL(sa.AvgScrRead, 0) + IFNULL(sa.AvgScrMath, 0) + IFNULL(sa.AvgScrWrite, 0)) AS combined_sat
  FROM satscores sa 
  WHERE sa.rtype = 'S' -- individual school reports
    AND sa.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL AND sa.AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL AND sa.AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  f.funding_category,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.CDSCode) AS num_active_schools,
  SUM(f.enrollment) AS total_2014_15_k12_enrollment,
  ROUND(AVG(f.meal_eligible_pct), 2) AS avg_pct_meal_eligible,
  ROUND(AVG(s.combined_sat), 2) AS avg_combined_sat_score
FROM frpm_active_charter f
LEFT JOIN sat_scores s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
GROUP BY f.funding_category
ORDER BY f.funding_category
LIMIT 1000

WITH state_special_schools AS (
  SELECT
    CDSCode,
    School,
    GSserved
  FROM schools
  WHERE State = 'CA'
    AND DOCType = 'State Special'
    AND StatusType = 'Active'
    AND GSserved IS NOT NULL AND GSserved != ''
),
school_lowest_grade AS (
  SELECT
    CDSCode,
    School,
    GSserved,
    -- Extracts text before hyphen, trims spaces
    TRIM(LOWER(
      CASE
        WHEN instr(GSserved, '-') > 0 THEN substr(GSserved, 1, instr(GSserved, '-')-1)
        ELSE GSserved
      END
    )) AS lowest_grade_code
  FROM state_special_schools
),
grade_order AS (
  SELECT 'p' AS code, 0 AS gorder UNION ALL
  SELECT 'k', 1 UNION ALL
  SELECT '1', 2 UNION ALL
  SELECT '2', 3 UNION ALL
  SELECT '3', 4 UNION ALL
  SELECT '4', 5 UNION ALL
  SELECT '5', 6 UNION ALL
  SELECT '6', 7 UNION ALL
  SELECT '7', 8 UNION ALL
  SELECT '8', 9 UNION ALL
  SELECT '9', 10 UNION ALL
  SELECT '10', 11 UNION ALL
  SELECT '11', 12 UNION ALL
  SELECT '12', 13
),
school_grade_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    s.CDSCode,
    s.School,
    s.GSserved,
    s.lowest_grade_code,
    g.gorder AS lowest_grade_order
  FROM school_lowest_grade s
  LEFT JOIN grade_order g ON g.code = s.lowest_grade_code
),
sat_2014 AS (
  SELECT
    cds,
    SUM(NumTstTakr) AS NumTstTakr
  FROM satscores
  WHERE rtype = 'S'
    AND substr(cds,1,2) = '19' -- CA CDS code (could omit)
    AND (satscores.sname IS NOT NULL)
  GROUP BY cds
),
merged AS (
  SELECT
    sgr.CDSCode,
    sgr.School,
    sgr.GSserved,
    sgr.lowest_grade_order,
    sgr.lowest_grade_code,
    COALESCE(sat_2014.NumTstTakr, 0) AS sat_test_takers
  FROM school_grade_ranked sgr
  LEFT JOIN sat_2014 ON sat_2014.cds = sgr.CDSCode
)
SELECT
  School AS school_name,
  UPPER(lowest_grade_code) AS earliest_grade_level,
  NULL AS k12_enrollment, -- True K-12 enrollment not available in schema
  sat_test_takers
FROM merged
WHERE lowest_grade_order IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY lowest_grade_order DESC, k12_enrollment DESC, school_name ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH latest_frpm AS (
  SELECT f.*
  FROM frpm f
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT [CDSCode], MAX([Academic Year]) AS max_year
    FROM frpm
    GROUP BY [CDSCode]
  ) lf ON f.[CDSCode] = lf.[CDSCode] AND f.[Academic Year] = lf.max_year
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(s.FundingType, lf.[Charter Funding Type]) AS FundingType,
  COUNT(*) AS num_schools,
  SUM(lf.[Enrollment (K-12)]) AS total_k12_enrollment,
  SUM(lf.[FRPM Count (K-12)]) AS total_frpm_k12
FROM schools s
INNER JOIN latest_frpm lf ON s.CDSCode = lf.CDSCode
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
  AND s.Charter = 1
  AND s.DOCType = 'County Office'
  AND COALESCE(s.FundingType, lf.[Charter Funding Type]) IN ('Directly Funded', 'Locally Funded')
GROUP BY FundingType
ORDER BY CASE FundingType WHEN 'Directly Funded' THEN 0 WHEN 'Locally Funded' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END

),
-- 3. The first-printed set for Abyssal Horror
first_abyssal_horror_set AS (
  SELECT set_code, releaseDate
  FROM abyssal_horror_sets
  WHERE (releaseDate, set_code) = (
    SELECT MIN(releaseDate), MIN(set_code)
    FROM abyssal_horror_sets
    WHERE releaseDate = (SELECT MIN(releaseDate) FROM abyssal_horror_sets)
  )
  LIMIT 1
),
-- 4. The most recently released set in the database
most_recent_set AS (
  SELECT code AS set_code, releaseDate
  FROM sets
  WHERE (releaseDate, code) = (
    SELECT MAX(releaseDate), MIN(code)
    FROM sets
    WHERE releaseDate = (SELECT MAX(releaseDate) FROM sets)
  )
  LIMIT 1
),
-- 5. Gather both needed sets
selected_sets AS (
  SELECT set_code, releaseDate FROM first_abyssal_horror_set
  UNION ALL
  SELECT set_code, releaseDate FROM most_recent_set
),
-- 6. For each set, count cards with a mana cost, and those with convertedManaCost <= 3
cards_with_counts AS (
  SELECT
    ss.set_code,
    s.name AS set_name,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.manaCost IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(c.manaCost) <> '' THEN 1 END) AS cards_with_mana_cost,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.manaCost IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(c.manaCost) <> '' AND c.convertedManaCost <= 3 THEN 1 END) AS cards_mana_3_or_less
  FROM selected_sets ss
  JOIN sets s ON s.code = ss.set_code
  JOIN cards c ON c.setCode = ss.set_code
  GROUP BY ss.set_code, s.name
)
SELECT
  set_name,
  ROUND(
    CASE WHEN cards_with_mana_cost > 0
         THEN (cards_mana_3_or_less * 100.0) / cards_with_mana_cost
         ELSE NULL END
    , 2
  ) AS pct_mana_3_or_less
FROM cards_with_counts
ORDER BY set_name;

  SELECT district_id, A11 AS inhabitants, A12 AS avg_salary
  FROM district
  WHERE A11 >= 100000
),
monthly_accts_1997 AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id
  FROM account a
  WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
    AND a.date >= '1997-01-01' AND a.date < '1998-01-01'
),
-- Districts with at least one monthly statement account opened in 1997
active_districts AS (
  SELECT qd.district_id, qd.avg_salary
  FROM qualifying_districts qd
  JOIN monthly_accts_1997 ma ON qd.district_id = ma.district_id
  GROUP BY qd.district_id
)
SELECT 
  COUNT(ma.account_id) AS total_monthly_statement_accounts,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ad.district_id) AS num_qualified_districts,
  ROUND(AVG(ad.avg_salary),2) AS avg_salary_across_districts
FROM monthly_accts_1997 ma
JOIN active_districts ad ON ma.district_id = ad.district_id

WITH gold_credit_accounts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id, a.district_id
  FROM account a
  JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
  JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
  WHERE c.type = 'gold'
),
district_info AS (
  SELECT
    district_id,
    A2 AS district_name,
    A3 AS region
  FROM district
),
trans_external AS (
  SELECT
    t.account_id,
    t.type,
    t.amount,
    t.bank,
    t.account,
    CASE WHEN t.bank IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(t.bank) <> '' THEN t.bank || '_' || t.account END AS ext_counterparty
  FROM trans t
),
agg_trans AS (
  SELECT
    g.account_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_amount_received,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_amount_withdrawn,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.ext_counterparty IS NOT NULL THEN t.ext_counterparty END) AS num_external_counterparties
  FROM gold_credit_accounts g
  LEFT JOIN trans_external t ON g.account_id = t.account_id
  GROUP BY g.account_id
),
loan_counts AS (
  SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS num_loans
  FROM loan
  GROUP BY account_id
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    g.account_id,
    d.district_name,
    d.region,
    COALESCE(a.total_amount_received, 0) AS total_amount_received,
    COALESCE(a.total_amount_withdrawn, 0) AS total_amount_withdrawn,
    COALESCE(l.num_loans, 0) AS num_loans,
    COALESCE(a.num_external_counterparties, 0) AS num_external_counterparties
  FROM gold_credit_accounts g
  LEFT JOIN district_info d ON g.district_id = d.district_id
  LEFT JOIN agg_trans a ON g.account_id = a.account_id
  LEFT JOIN loan_counts l ON g.account_id = l.account_id
),
with_ranks AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY num_external_counterparties DESC) AS ext_network_rank
  FROM final
)
SELECT
  account_id,
  district_name,
  region,
  total_amount_received,
  total_amount_withdrawn,
  num_loans,
  num_external_counterparties,
  ext_network_rank
FROM with_ranks
ORDER BY ext_network_rank, account_id;

WITH gold_card_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id, a.district_id
    FROM card c
    JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
    JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE c.type = 'gold' AND d.type = 'OWNER'
),
district_info AS (
    SELECT district_id, A2 as district_name, A3 as region_name
    FROM district
),
loans_per_account AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS num_loans
    FROM loan
    GROUP BY account_id
),
trans_summary AS (
    SELECT
        t.account_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS amount_received,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS amount_withdrawn,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.bank IS NOT NULL THEN (t.bank || '-' || COALESCE(CAST(t.account AS TEXT),'')) END) AS num_external_counterparties
    FROM trans t
    GROUP BY t.account_id
)
SELECT 
    g.account_id,
    d.district_name,
    d.region_name,
    COALESCE(ts.amount_received,0) AS total_amount_received,
    COALESCE(ts.amount_withdrawn,0) AS total_amount_withdrawn,
    COALESCE(l.num_loans,0) AS num_loans,
    COALESCE(ts.num_external_counterparties,0) AS num_external_counterparties,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(ts.num_external_counterparties,0) DESC) as external_counterparty_rank
FROM gold_card_accounts g
LEFT JOIN district_info d ON g.district_id = d.district_id
LEFT JOIN loans_per_account l ON g.account_id = l.account_id
LEFT JOIN trans_summary ts ON g.account_id = ts.account_id
ORDER BY external_counterparty_rank, g.account_id
LIMIT 1000

WITH tabor_accounts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, a.date AS date_opened
    FROM account a
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE d.A2 = 'Tabor'
      AND a.date <= '1996-12-31'
),
owner_info AS (
    SELECT disp.account_id, client.gender, 
           CAST((julianday('1996-12-31') - julianday(client.birth_date)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS age
    FROM disp
    JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
    WHERE disp.type = 'OWNER'
),
cards_per_acct AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(card.card_id) AS cards_issued
    FROM tabor_accounts a
    LEFT JOIN disp ON a.account_id = disp.account_id
    LEFT JOIN card ON disp.disp_id = card.disp_id AND card.issued <= '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY a.account_id
),
loans_per_acct AS (
    SELECT a.account_id,
           COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loans_approved,
           SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS defaulted,
           SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('C','D') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repaying,
           SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS paid_off
    FROM tabor_accounts a
    LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id AND l.date <= '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY a.account_id
),
loan_label AS (
    SELECT l.account_id,
           CASE
             WHEN l.loans_approved = 0 THEN 'no loan'
             WHEN l.defaulted > 0 THEN 'defaulted'
             WHEN l.repaying > 0 THEN 'repaying'
             ELSE 'paid off'
           END AS loan_standing
    FROM loans_per_acct l
),
trans_97 AS (
    SELECT a.account_id,
           COUNT(t.trans_id) AS tx_count,
           SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'credit' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_in,
           SUM(CASE WHEN t.type IN ('debit', 'withdrawal') THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_out
    FROM tabor_accounts a
    LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id AND t.date >= '1997-01-01' AND t.date <= '1997-12-31'
    GROUP BY a.account_id
),
peak_balance AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, COALESCE(MAX(t.balance), 0) AS peak_balance_97
    FROM tabor_accounts a
    LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id AND t.date >= '1997-01-01' AND t.date <= '1997-12-31'
    GROUP BY a.account_id
),
account_profiles AS (
    SELECT
        ta.account_id,
        ta.date_opened,
        oi.gender,
        oi.age,
        cp.cards_issued,
        lp.loans_approved,
        ll.loan_standing,
        t97.tx_count,
        t97.money_in,
        t97.money_out,
        pb.peak_balance_97
    FROM tabor_accounts ta
    LEFT JOIN owner_info oi ON ta.account_id = oi.account_id
    LEFT JOIN cards_per_acct cp ON ta.account_id = cp.account_id
    LEFT JOIN loans_per_acct lp ON ta.account_id = lp.account_id
    LEFT JOIN loan_label ll ON ta.account_id = ll.account_id
    LEFT JOIN trans_97 t97 ON ta.account_id = t97.account_id
    LEFT JOIN peak_balance pb ON ta.account_id = pb.account_id
)
SELECT
    account_id,
    date_opened,
    gender,
    age,
    COALESCE(cards_issued, 0) AS cards_issued,
    COALESCE(loans_approved, 0) AS loans_approved,
    COALESCE(loan_standing, 'no loan') AS loan_standing,
    COALESCE(tx_count, 0) AS tx_count_97,
    COALESCE(money_in, 0) AS money_in_97,
    COALESCE(money_out, 0) AS money_out_97,
    COALESCE(peak_balance_97, 0) AS peak_balance_97,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(peak_balance_97, 0) DESC, account_id ASC) AS balance_rank_97
FROM account_profiles
ORDER BY balance_rank_97, account_id;

WITH tabor_accounts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, a.date AS open_date, a.district_id
    FROM account a
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE d.A2 = 'Tabor'
),
owner_disp AS (
    SELECT d.account_id, d.client_id
    FROM disp d
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
),
owner_profile AS (
    SELECT ta.account_id, ta.open_date, c.gender, 
           CAST((strftime('%Y', '1996-12-31') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date)) - (strftime('%m-%d', '1996-12-31') < strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date)) AS INTEGER) AS owner_age
    FROM tabor_accounts ta
    JOIN owner_disp od ON ta.account_id = od.account_id
    JOIN client c ON od.client_id = c.client_id
),
cards_pre1997 AS (
    SELECT d.account_id, COUNT(*) AS num_cards
    FROM card ca
    JOIN disp d ON ca.disp_id = d.disp_id
    WHERE ca.issued <= '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY d.account_id
),
loans_pre1997 AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS num_loans,
           MAX(CASE WHEN status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_default,
           MAX(CASE WHEN status IN ('C','D') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_repaying,
           MAX(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_paid
    FROM loan
    WHERE date <= '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY account_id
),
loan_labels AS (
    SELECT ta.account_id,
           CASE 
             WHEN lp.account_id IS NULL THEN 'no loan'
             WHEN lp.has_default = 1 THEN 'defaulted'
             WHEN lp.has_repaying = 1 THEN 'repaying'
             WHEN lp.has_paid = 1 THEN 'paid off'
             ELSE 'paid off'
           END AS loan_label,
           COALESCE(lp.num_loans, 0) AS num_loans
    FROM tabor_accounts ta
    LEFT JOIN loans_pre1997 lp ON ta.account_id = lp.account_id
),
trans_1997 AS (
    SELECT account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS num_trans,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'credit' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_in,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type IN ('debit', 'withdrawal') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_out,
           MAX(balance) AS peak_balance
    FROM trans
    WHERE date BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
    GROUP BY account_id
),
with_all_fields AS (
    SELECT op.account_id, op.open_date, op.gender, op.owner_age,
           COALESCE(cp.num_cards, 0) AS num_cards,
           ll.num_loans,
           ll.loan_label,
           COALESCE(t97.num_trans, 0) AS num_trans,
           COALESCE(t97.money_in, 0) AS money_in,
           COALESCE(t97.money_out, 0) AS money_out,
           COALESCE(t97.peak_balance, 0) AS peak_balance
    FROM owner_profile op
    LEFT JOIN cards_pre1997 cp ON op.account_id = cp.account_id
    LEFT JOIN loan_labels ll ON op.account_id = ll.account_id
    LEFT JOIN trans_1997 t97 ON op.account_id = t97.account_id
)
SELECT *,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY peak_balance DESC, account_id ASC) AS peak_balance_rank
FROM with_all_fields
ORDER BY peak_balance DESC, account_id ASC
LIMIT 1000

WITH classic_card_owners AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.client_id, d.account_id
    FROM disp d
    JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER' AND c.type = 'classic'
),
accounts_by_district AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id
    FROM account a
),
district_names AS (
    SELECT district_id, A2 AS district_name FROM district
),
all_districts AS (
    SELECT district_id, district_name FROM district_names
),
owners_in_district AS (
    SELECT abo.district_id, cco.client_id
    FROM classic_card_owners cco
    JOIN accounts_by_district abo ON cco.account_id = abo.account_id
),
clients_per_district AS (
    SELECT ad.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT oid.client_id) AS client_count
    FROM all_districts ad
    LEFT JOIN owners_in_district oid ON ad.district_id = oid.district_id
    GROUP BY ad.district_id
),
external_payments AS (
    SELECT t.trans_id, t.account_id, t.bank, t.account, t.amount
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ' AND t.bank IS NOT NULL AND t.bank != '' AND t.account IS NOT NULL
),
payments_joined AS (
    SELECT abo.district_id, ep.account_id, ep.bank, ep.account, ep.amount
    FROM classic_card_owners cco
    JOIN accounts_by_district abo ON cco.account_id = abo.account_id
    JOIN external_payments ep ON cco.account_id = ep.account_id
),
payments_agg AS (
    SELECT ad.district_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT pj.bank || '-' || pj.account) AS external_account_count,
           COALESCE(SUM(pj.amount), 0) AS total_outgoing_amount
    FROM all_districts ad
    LEFT JOIN payments_joined pj ON ad.district_id = pj.district_id
    GROUP BY ad.district_id
)
SELECT
    ad.district_name,
    COALESCE(cpd.client_count, 0) AS client_count,
    COALESCE(pa.external_account_count, 0) AS external_account_count,
    COALESCE(pa.total_outgoing_amount, 0) AS total_outgoing_amount
FROM
    all_districts ad
    LEFT JOIN clients_per_district cpd ON ad.district_id = cpd.district_id
    LEFT JOIN payments_agg pa ON ad.district_id = pa.district_id
ORDER BY
    pa.total_outgoing_amount DESC,
    ad.district_name ASC
;

treatment.sql:
WITH owner_disp AS (
  SELECT disp.disp_id, disp.client_id, disp.account_id
  FROM disp
  WHERE disp.type = 'OWNER'
),
classic_card_disp AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.client_id, d.account_id, d.disp_id
  FROM card c
  JOIN owner_disp d ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
  WHERE c.type = 'classic'
),
account_branch AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id as branch_district_id
  FROM account a
),
relevant_account_owner AS (
  SELECT cc.client_id, cc.account_id, ab.branch_district_id
  FROM classic_card_disp cc
  JOIN account_branch ab ON cc.account_id = ab.account_id
),
distinct_owner_per_branch AS (
  -- Get distinct owner per client per branch (a client might own multiple accounts in a branch, count once)
  SELECT branch_district_id, client_id
  FROM relevant_account_owner
  GROUP BY branch_district_id, client_id
),
ext_payments AS (
  -- Outgoing payments by those accounts, where destination is external (bank IS NOT NULL)
  SELECT rao.branch_district_id, t.account_id, t.amount, t.bank, t.account
  FROM relevant_account_owner rao
  JOIN trans t ON rao.account_id = t.account_id
  WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ' AND t.bank IS NOT NULL
),
branch_ext_accounts AS (
  -- External accounts per branch: count unique (bank, account)
  SELECT branch_district_id, bank, account
  FROM ext_payments
  GROUP BY branch_district_id, bank, account
),

by_branch AS (
  SELECT 
    d.district_id as branch_district_id,
    d.A2 as district_name,
    COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT dopb.client_id), 0) as num_classic_card_owners,
    COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT bea.bank || '-' || bea.account), 0) as num_external_accounts,
    COALESCE(SUM(ep.amount), 0) as total_outgoing_amount
  FROM district d
  LEFT JOIN distinct_owner_per_branch dopb ON d.district_id = dopb.branch_district_id
  LEFT JOIN branch_ext_accounts bea ON d.district_id = bea.branch_district_id
  LEFT JOIN ext_payments ep ON d.district_id = ep.branch_district_id
  GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2
)
SELECT 
  district_name,
  num_classic_card_owners,
  num_external_accounts,
  total_outgoing_amount
FROM by_branch
ORDER BY total_outgoing_amount DESC, district_name ASC
LIMIT 1000

WITH lucas_id AS (

  FROM drivers
  WHERE forename = 'Lucas' AND surname = 'di Grassi'
),
races_2010 AS (
  SELECT raceId
  FROM races
  WHERE year = 2010
),
lucas_qual AS (
  SELECT q1.raceId, q1.driverId, q1.position AS lucas_position
  FROM qualifying q1
  JOIN lucas_id l ON q1.driverId = l.driverId
  WHERE q1.raceId IN (SELECT raceId FROM races_2010)

WITH rare_elements AS (
  -- Find elements (by atom.element) that appear in only one molecule
  SELECT a.element, a.molecule_id
  FROM atom a
  GROUP BY a.element
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) = 1
),
carcinogenic_rare_molecules AS (
  -- Out of the rare atoms, keep only those whose molecule is carcinogenic
  SELECT re.element, re.molecule_id
  FROM rare_elements re
  JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = re.molecule_id
  WHERE m.label = '+'
),
rare_atoms_in_carcinogenic AS (
  -- Atoms in carcinogenic molecules with rare elements
  SELECT a.atom_id, a.molecule_id, a.element
  FROM atom a
  JOIN carcinogenic_rare_molecules crm
    ON a.molecule_id = crm.molecule_id AND a.element = crm.element
),
atoms_in_bond AS (
  -- Find all bonds and the atoms in them by linking through 'atom' table
  SELECT
    b.bond_id,
    a.atom_id,
    b.molecule_id
  FROM bond b
  JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id -- bonds scoped per molecule
),
bond_count AS (
  -- Count bonds each rare atom participates in, per molecule
  SELECT
    rat.molecule_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ab.bond_id) AS rare_element_bond_count
  FROM rare_atoms_in_carcinogenic rat
  JOIN atoms_in_bond ab ON rat.atom_id = ab.atom_id AND rat.molecule_id = ab.molecule_id
  GROUP BY rat.molecule_id
)
SELECT molecule_id, rare_element_bond_count
FROM bond_count
ORDER BY molecule_id;

WITH carbon_atoms AS (
  SELECT a.molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS num_carbons
  FROM atom a
  WHERE a.element = 'C'
  GROUP BY a.molecule_id
),
chlorine_atoms AS (
  SELECT a.molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS num_chlorines
  FROM atom a
  WHERE a.element = 'Cl'
  GROUP BY a.molecule_id
),
atom_counts AS (
  SELECT a.molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS num_atoms
  FROM atom a
  GROUP BY a.molecule_id
),
bond_counts AS (
  SELECT b.molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS num_bonds
  FROM bond b
  GROUP BY b.molecule_id
),
carbon_touching_bonds AS (
  -- carbon-touching: a bond where either atom is a carbon (count bond once if both are carbon)
  SELECT b.molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS num_carbon_touching_bonds
  FROM bond b
  JOIN atom a1 ON b.molecule_id = a1.molecule_id AND b.bond_id = b.bond_id AND a1.element = 'C'
  GROUP BY b.molecule_id
),
multiple_bonds AS (
  SELECT b.molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS num_multiple_bonds
  FROM bond b
  WHERE b.bond_type IN ('double', 'triple')
  GROUP BY b.molecule_id
),
with_ranking AS (
  SELECT
    m.molecule_id,
    m.label AS carcinogenicity,
    COALESCE(ac.num_atoms, 0) AS num_atoms,
    COALESCE(bc.num_bonds, 0) AS num_bonds,
    COALESCE(ca.num_carbons, 0) AS num_carbons,
    COALESCE(cl.num_chlorines, 0) AS num_chlorines,
    COALESCE(ctb.num_carbon_touching_bonds, 0) AS num_carbon_touching_bonds,
    COALESCE(mb.num_multiple_bonds, 0) AS num_multiple_bonds
  FROM molecule m
  LEFT JOIN carbon_atoms ca ON m.molecule_id = ca.molecule_id
  LEFT JOIN chlorine_atoms cl ON m.molecule_id = cl.molecule_id
  LEFT JOIN atom_counts ac ON m.molecule_id = ac.molecule_id
  LEFT JOIN bond_counts bc ON m.molecule_id = bc.molecule_id
  LEFT JOIN carbon_touching_bonds ctb ON m.molecule_id = ctb.molecule_id
  LEFT JOIN multiple_bonds mb ON m.molecule_id = mb.molecule_id
  WHERE COALESCE(ca.num_carbons, 0) >= 1
)
SELECT
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    ORDER BY num_carbon_touching_bonds DESC, num_atoms DESC, molecule_id ASC
  ) AS rank,
  molecule_id,
  carcinogenicity,
  num_atoms,
  num_bonds,
  num_carbons,
  num_chlorines,
  num_carbon_touching_bonds,
  num_multiple_bonds
FROM with_ranking
ORDER BY rank
LIMIT 1000

  JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
  WHERE a.element = 'C'
  GROUP BY b.molecule_id
),
full_inventory AS (
  SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label,
    ac.num_atoms, bc.num_bonds, ac.num_c_atoms, ac.num_cl_atoms,
    COALESCE(ctb.num_c_touch_bonds,0) AS num_c_touch_bonds,

  LEFT JOIN atom_counts ac ON m.molecule_id = ac.molecule_id
  LEFT JOIN bond_counts bc ON m.molecule_id = bc.molecule_id
  LEFT JOIN carbon_touching_bonds ctb ON m.molecule_id = ctb.molecule_id

  molecule_id, label, num_atoms, num_bonds, num_c_atoms, num_cl_atoms, num_c_touch_bonds, num_mult_bonds
